corrections.text: The article says "The Internet Archive's index lists other captures in between; the Herald did not compare each of them." The Internet Archive's index records four distinct versions of the PDF between 8 and 11 November (captures from 8 November 22:02 UTC, 9 November 11:59 UTC, 9 November 19:25 UTC and 11 November 19:32 UTC). The 9 November 11:59 UTC capture already reads "steward body" and no longer contains "hence Bjarne’s dissent was the pivotal factor" or the "if even one had voted in favor" sentence, so the paper changed in several steps and several of the listed differences were already in place on 9 November.

The article reports The Register's counts of 13 votes for, 9 against and 12 abstentions. The ISO ballot is not public, and neither the paper nor Mateusz Pusz's post gives a tally, so the Herald found no primary record of these counts; they rest on The Register alone. Pusz writes that ISO's full ballot report is due by mid-January 2027 at the latest.
